answer: For a karst wharf shelter against the zephyr, each ballot needs a distinct $10 deposit bound to it and the poll. The server rejects missing or reused deposits. Officials randomly audit ballots against photo ID and the voter roll; failed checks forfeit the associated deposit, while others are refunded. Each extra ballot ties up $10 and risks forfeiture if audited. Audits can miss aliases, and borrowed IDs can pass.
